title.narrative: Protection of unaccompanied refugee and migrant children in Türkiye
Stärkande av skyddet för ensamkommande flykting­ och migrantbarn i Turkiet

description.narrative: Genomförandeperioden är 1 januari 2026 – 30 juni 2027. Insatsen bygger på Europarådets tidigare erfarenheter inom området. Insatsen syftar till att stärka skyddet för ensamkommande migrant och flyktingbarn i Turkiet i linje med europeiska och internationella normer. Arbetet kommer inriktas på att utveckla policyer och metoder som möter de särskilda behov som ensamkommande barn har, och säkerställa att deras perspektiv, erfarenheter och medverkan beaktas i frågor som rör dem. Insatsen förväntas bidra till att utveckla system som värnar barns rättigheter och välbefinnande.

The implementation period is January 1, 2026 – June 30, 2027. The contribution builds on the Council of Europe’s previous experience in this area. The contribution aims to strengthen the protection of unaccompanied migrant and refugee children in Turkey in line with European and international standards. The work will focus on developing policies and methods that address the specific needs of unaccompanied children, and ensuring that their perspectives, experiences, and participation are taken into account in matters that concern them. The contribution is expected to contribute to the development of systems that safeguard children’s rights and well-being.

The proposed Project aims to provide targeted support to strengthen the protection of unaccompanied migrant children. To achieve this, the Project is structured around the following three key pillars: 1) Strengthening the capacities of national authorities to respond to the specific needs of unaccompanied migrant children 2) Supporting unaccompanied migrant children in transition to adulthood 3) Increasing awareness of rights and promoting empowerment among unaccompanied children in migration
